other_conditions: Minimum disability of 40 percent is required.
Applicant must not be receiving any other pension or grant such as old age pension, widow pension, socialist pension, or any similar scheme.
Applicant must not be receiving free maintenance in government institutions or homes.
Annual income of the applicant or family must be within the defined poverty line (₹46,080 per year in rural areas or ₹56,460 per year in urban areas).
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly grant of Rs. 1,000 to each eligible disabled beneficiary.
